g.text: Teensy 4.0 + Audio Rev D (USB to the left face)

svg.text: eTuttino PCB (Hall effect, case v7) — top view
44 keys · C-griff G3–E6 · hex grid, pitch 18.5 mm, rows 16.02 mm apart · board 1.2 mm, shaped to the case
44 × Gateron magnetic switch (no pins) · 44 × DRV5056A3 sensor on the BACK · 3 × CD74HC4067 + AMS1117-3.3 on the back (dashed)
Key label: switch · MUX/channel · - - - plate edge · dashed blue: bottom-plate pillars (no parts on the back there)
Mux address S0..S3 → pins 0, 1, 2, 3 · MUX1/2/3 output → pins 14, 15, 16 · J3: pot 22, encoder 17/9/6, LED 4/5
